summary: Texas County, MO steel fire tower erected 1960 at 120 ft on an MDC towersite; 2015 plan notes a locked gate; July 2026 action split the site, tower's fate not stated.

facts.status_note: Last physical description found is the 2015 area plan; a July 2026 Commission action approved splitting the towersite but does not name the tower

staffing.status: 2015 plan refers to fire lookout personnel; no staffing dates given

access.note: 2015 plan lists a locked gate at the entrance; the MDC towersite page lists public-use hours for the area (4:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily) but says nothing about entering the tower. Current gate status not found.

visit.trail_note: MDC towersite page: from Cabool, take Route M north 2 miles. No tower-specific visiting rules found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: MDC's site page lists 15.5 acres. The July 2026 action splits about 6.1 and 9.6 acres, which add to about 15.7. Both figures are approximate, so we report 15.5 as the total.

notes_for_editor: Record id is us-mo-unnamed, but the sources call this the Cabool fire tower; id left as is. Build year and height agree across two sources. The Cabool towersite is in Texas County, and the record's Texas County is correct. The MDC towersite page gives the directions 'From Cabool, take Route M north 2 miles' and public-use hours for the area; both are now cited. A Facebook post (not fetched; search snippet only) says the same directions; not cited. The sources read do not say which side of the site holds the tower or what happens to it after the July 2026 action; a follow-up could check the MDC towersite map or a later Commission action. Fact-check 2026-10-09: facts.status changed from 'standing' to 'unknown' and access.level from 'restricted' to 'unknown', because the 2015 plan is the last physical description and its locked-gate note is dated.
